parties.petitioner: Krishna Devi @ Sabitri Devi (Rani) M/S S.R. Engineering Construction

summary: Arbitral award execution timing dispute; commencement of limitation period under Arbitration Act 1940 s.14; whether formal notice required vs. knowledge of award sufficient; reliance on Nilkantha Sidramappa Ningashetti and Deo Narain Choudhury precedents; award filed on 31.05.2022; order dated 21.09.2022 directing payment of arbitrator fees deemed sufficient notice; limitation period commenced from 21.09.2022; premature objection by respondent dismissed; application under s.17 for judgment pronouncement allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Arbitration Act, 1940 s.3, s.14, s.17, s.38
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court and District Court judgments set aside; respondent directed to pay award amount with interest.
